Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer fabricated the final answer “Wen Jia Bao” without evidence from the retrieved results, misusing incomplete search snippets and skipping the planned verification of the OpenCV version and contributor list (Rule 2). This premature finalization made recovery impossible by short-circuiting the remaining steps needed to confirm the correct name (Rule 3), and no loop dynamics mitigated this error (Rule 1).
